subject: Open on Saturdays?
body: Hi, I work weekdays and can't get away during business hours. Do you have any Saturday appointments, or are you weekdays only?

subject: Friday after Thanksgiving
body: I'd like to book a cleaning for the Friday after Thanksgiving since I have the day off. Is the office open that day?

subject: How long is a first appointment?
body: I'm a new patient and need to know how much time to block off work for my first visit. How long does it usually take?

subject: Whitening before a wedding
body: I'm in a wedding in three weeks and want to get my teeth whitened. How long is an in-office whitening appointment, and do I need more than one visit?

subject: Payment plan for a crown and two fillings
body: My treatment plan came out to about $1,800 and I can't pay that all at once. Do you offer any kind of payment plan or financing?

subject: No insurance - is there a cash price?
body: I don't have dental insurance right now. Do you offer any discount for paying out of pocket, or is it the full rate?

subject: Why did I pay at check-in?
body: I was asked to pay $85 when I checked in yesterday before the claim even went to my insurance. What was that charge for?
expected_chunk: insurance-and-billing.md#What we collect at the visit

subject: Bill doesn't match what I paid at my visit
body: I paid an estimate at my appointment last month and now I've received a statement for an additional $40. Why is the amount different from what I already paid?
expected_chunk: insurance-and-billing.md#What we collect at the visit

subject: Do you take Delta Dental PPO?
body: My employer just switched us to Delta Dental PPO. Are you in-network with that plan? I want to make sure before I book.

subject: Aetna DMO coverage
body: I have Aetna DMO through my spouse's job. Will my visits be covered at your office, or are you out of network for that?

subject: Are two cleanings a year covered?
body: I had a cleaning in February and want to schedule another. Will my insurance cover a second cleaning this year or will I be paying for it?

subject: Insurance card for first visit
body: I'm coming in for my first appointment next week. Do I need to bring my physical insurance card, or is the member ID enough?

subject: Eating after a filling
body: I just had a filling done this morning and my mouth is still numb. How long do I have to wait before I can eat something?

subject: Temporary crown feels loose
body: I got a temporary crown last week and it feels a little loose when I chew. Is that normal while I wait for the permanent one, or should I come in?

subject: First dentist visit for a toddler
body: My daughter is 18 months old and has about eight teeth. Is she old enough to be seen, or should we wait until she's older?

subject: Knocked out tooth - what do I do
body: My son just got hit in the mouth playing basketball and one of his front teeth came out completely. It's after 6pm. What should we do right now?

subject: Parking near the office
body: Coming in for the first time next Tuesday. Is there parking at the building, or do I need to find street parking?

subject: Sending records to my new dentist
body: We're relocating to Denver next month. Can you send my file and my most recent X-rays to my new dentist there? What do you need from me to do that?

subject: Dental supply vendor introduction
body: Hello, I represent a regional dental supply distributor and would love 15 minutes with whoever handles purchasing for your practice. Who is the best contact?

subject: Hiring hygienists?
body: I'm a licensed dental hygienist moving to the area and wondering if you have any openings. Where should I send my resume?

subject: Bad toothache
body: I've had a throbbing pain in a lower molar since last night and it's getting worse. Do I need to come in today?

subject: Swelling after my extraction
body: I had a tooth pulled on Monday. Since yesterday my cheek on that side is swollen and I feel feverish. Is that normal or should I be seen?

subject: Crown cracked and it hurts
body: I bit down on something hard at lunch and my crown cracked. There's a sharp edge cutting my tongue and the tooth underneath hurts when I drink anything cold. What should I do?

subject: Gums bleeding a bit after cleaning
body: I had my cleaning last week and my gums bled a little when I flossed last night. Is that normal after a cleaning or something I should worry about?
